message: No detected input validation: The code passes paramDict directly into predictScore and getModelPrediction without any schema, type, or value-range checks; empty strings are silently replaced with 0 but no structural validation is performed.
No detected untrusted source handling: Model files are loaded from local paths (TreeFiles/) using pickle.load with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote fetch.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the visible data preparation or training code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via pickle (e.g., `pickle.dump`/`loadMVDDFromFile`) and dot files without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity before use.

No detected label distribution validation: The training code uses StratifiedKFold which preserves class proportions during splitting, but there is no explicit check or validation of label distribution or class balance before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or any other backdoor defense mechanism present in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or custom DP mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the training code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any stress-testing against adversarial inputs are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While cross-validation with stratified k-fold splits is used, there is no held-out test set isolation enforced programmatically, no signing/hashing of evaluation data, and no independent verification mechanism to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The paramDict is passed directly to predictScore without any shape, type, range, or schema validation; the only handling is replacing empty strings with 0 inside getModelPrediction.

No detected output bounds checks: The score returned by predictScore is cast to int and used in if/elif branches, but there is no guard for NaN, None, out-of-range values, or unexpected scores before returning to the caller.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it uses a Multi-Valued Decision Diagram (MVDD) for clinical risk scoring, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
